Fitness Copilot anatomical model credits and reuse terms

BodyParts3D, © The Database Center for Life Science.
Original dataset: https://lifesciencedb.jp/bp3d/
License: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 2.1 Japan
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.1/jp/deed.en

Z-Anatomy, by Gauthier Kervyn and the Z-Anatomy contributors.
Original project: https://github.com/Z-Anatomy/Models-of-human-anatomy
License for the anatomical meshes: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/

The model used by Fitness Copilot was obtained from Johan Bellander’s BodyExplorer:
https://github.com/JohanBellander/BodyExplorer
BodyExplorer decimated, aligned and combined the source meshes in anatomy.glb.
Its source code is MIT licensed; the included anatomical geometry retains the
applicable licenses of the original data sources listed above.

Fitness Copilot did not modify the distributed mesh geometry. The app assigns
colors, scale and rotation at runtime and provides muscle-to-exercise links.
The model file itself is available in the public repository at
https://github.com/ali5921592-lang/gym1.2/tree/main/dist/assets

Reuse of the geometry must follow the attribution and share-alike terms of its
underlying sources. These credits do not imply endorsement by the creators.
